name: General track
sub: For every major · understand first, then compute
desc: No deep learning background needed. Do the hand calculations, browser labs and explanation questions; the harder code walk-throughs are optional.

name: Systems engineering track
sub: All 28 chapters · from principles to code
desc: For computer science, electronics and cross-disciplinary engineering learners. Follow the prerequisites and finish the tiny engine, the source contracts and the verification project.

name: Research seminar track
sub: Some background already · focus on heterogeneity and correctness
desc: Bring your math and systems background into the source code. Focus on counterexamples, designs for reproducing results on real hardware, and multi-sequence extensions. The quality gates are not optional.
